STEP 1 — goal: check each of the 5 proposals against the frozen bundle (same bundle content for all: E5 successor-entropy stratification, E6 width-20 beam survival, E7 teacher-forced per-position NLL, E8 K-capacity ceiling, E9 cohort-profile signal, E10 out-degree, E12/E13 geometric declarations; per-proposal variants only in E1-E3/E12-E13).

Observations used for placement:
- E6: l1_br (collapsed deep level: gold prefix alive depth 1/2/3 = 1.000/1.000/1.000) is the WORST arm (recall@10 0.04671); good arms are l1_br_euclid 0.06207, l1_only 0.06233, resample 0.06363, all with depth-2/3 survival far below 1.0. So a degenerate deep level (collapse) is the measured blocker and the 0.0638 ceiling comes from arms that keep deep discriminability.
- E7: l1_br has T4 NLL 9.03 (unpredictable/collapsed last digit) while the top arm resample has T3/T4 NLL 0.73/0.05; deep-position predictability co-moves with recall.
- E10: mean outgoing degree 5.45; batch ~1023 of 24556 items -> only ~4% of an item's neighbours are in-batch, so any behaviour term restricted to in-batch pairs fires rarely.
- E8: K=256 keeps only 0.0822 of canonical pairs in one first cluster -> level-1 grouping is capacity-limited, level-3 occupancy is a separate structural problem.

Per-proposal reading:
- ANCHORLADDER (c=(-1,-0.5,0)): at level 3 curvature is exactly 0 and the per-item behaviour anchor is multiplied out (exp = identity), so the deep assignment is the plain Euclidean RQ whose l3_collision is the 0.549 baseline; no dispersion force anywhere. Its own <=0.35 hypothesis is unsupported by the bundle; also states B=256 vs frozen ~1023.
- signcurv-ladder: correct signed-curvature maps (sphere for kappa>0), derived gamma from first-batch median, but deep repulsion only over in-batch behaviour neighbours -> with E10 degree 5.45 and ~4% in-batch rate the level-3 dispersion is mostly the sphere geometry, which does not itself spread code usage; frozen first-batch gamma is a single-sample scale.
- dualramp-caprq: strongest occupancy guarantee (cap=ceil(B/K)=4) and sign-flipped level-3 repulsion consistent with the E6 diagnosis, but kappa_3=0 kills deep geometry, tau_l=0.1*mean(m_ij) is a non-derived constant (experiment policy: no tuned constants), and E12's tanh exp map is applied to positive kappa_l (formula valid only for kappa<0) -> geometry mislabeled; forced capacity can inflate hard ER above 4.
- strataot-curv-rq: curvature radius a_l from measured 90th-percentile residual norm and remaining mass q_l*S_1/S_l, cost includes geodesic distance to the Karcher mean of the successor codewords (attractive, aligns with E9 0.9291 positive-shares-cohort and with E7 deep NLL), plus uniform column marginal transport for spreading; weakness: attraction at level 3 pulls toward the same successor code that the column balance is pushing apart, and eps_l = mean min cost degenerates under collapse.
- TAPERINNOV-RQ: curvature kappa_l = u1^2/(s_1 s_l) derived from measured per-level residual RMS with load sqrt(kappa_l)s_l = u1 sqrt(s_l/s_1) <= 0.5 (directly fixes the diagnosed boundary-saturation cause), balanced log-domain Sinkhorn with uniform column marginal gives level-3 occupancy by construction, behaviour affinity enters the SAME cost with +1 at l<3 and -1 at l=3 and weight alpha_l = std(C_l)/std(B_l) (scale-equalised, no tuned weight). Weaknesses: batch-level balance need not survive argmin at eval; with colour-free h_3 the signed term can be near-constant under collapse (balance the

n does the work); deep repulsion may lower deep predictability that E6/E7 show separates 0.062 arms from 0.0638.

Provisional ranking (grounded): TAPERINNOV-RQ 1, strataot-curv-rq 2, dualramp-caprq 3, signcurv-ladder-rq-2026 4, ANCHORLADDER-RQ 5. Open: final answer to be appended as the last record.

STEP 2 — final answer (all five proposals ranked, positions 1..5, no ties).

{"ranking": [{"idea_id": "TAPERINNOV-RQ", "position": 1, "reason": "Only proposal whose curvature is DERIVED from the measured per-level residual RMS with a proved load bound (sqrt(kappa_l)*s_l = u1*sqrt(s_l/s_1) <= 0.5, so tanh never saturates), so it names the geometric cause it must remove -- the boundary saturation that E6/E7 exhibit in l1_br (gold prefix alive at depth 1/2/3 = 1.000/1.000/1.000, T4 NLL 9.03, recall 0.04671, worst arm) -- and it adds the one thing every collapsed arm lacked: level-3 occupancy by construction via a uniform-column Sinkhorn inside the same cost, with the behaviour affinity signed +1/-1 and weighted by alpha_l = std(C_l)/std(B_l) so no constant is tuned; keeps the E6/E7 first-order gain targets explicit (ER <= 4 vs measured 2.49-3.89, hit >= 0.12 vs 0.12-0.26) and Stage3 bar 0.065 vs best 0.0638."}, {"idea_id": "strataot-curv-rq", "position": 2, "reason": "Second-best grounded coupling: curvature radius a_l = q_l*S_1/S_l is measured from the bundle-consistent residual scale (so level 3 is nearly Euclidean, matching E12/E13), the ground cost adds the geodesic distance to the Karcher mean of the item's training successors -- which lines up with E9 (a positive shares its anchor's successor cohort 0.9291 vs 0.8871 for negatives) and with E7 where the top arms have low deep-position NLL (resample T3/T4 0.73/0.05) -- and the uniform column marginal is a real spreading force; placed below TAPERINNOV because its behaviour term stays ATTRACTIVE at level 3, directly opposing the marginal balance that is supposed to lift l3_collision off the measured 0.549, and eps_l = mean_i min_c C_ic collapses with the degenerate cost it is meant to fix."}, {"idea_id": "dualramp-caprq", "position": 3, "reason": "Hardest occupancy guarantee in the set (cap = ceil(B/K) = 4 per level-3 code) plus sign-flipped level-3 repulsion matches the E6/E7 diagnosis that the collapsed deep level is what killed recall (0.04671 for l1_br vs 0.06207/0.06363 for arms with live deep splits); demoted because kappa_3 = 0 deletes geometry exactly at the failing level, tau_l = 0.1*mean_ij m_ij is a hand-set constant the experiment policy forbids, and the E12 tanh exponential map is applied to kappa_l > 0 where a sphere (tan) map is required, so the curved operator is mislabeled; forced cap=4 also risks pushing hard ER above the 4 target set by the measured 2.49-3.89."}, {"idea_id": "signcurv-ladder-rq-2026", "position": 4, "reason": "Geometrically the most explicit signed-curvature spec (Poincare ball for kappa<0, sphere for kappa>0, exp/log for both, gamma_l derived from a frozen first-batch median with no tuned weight), but its level-3 dispersion relies on a repulsion over behaviour neighbours restricted to pairs whose both endpoints are in the current batch: with E10 mean out-degree 5.45 and ~1023 of 24556 items per step only a few percent of neighbours are in-batch, so the term is mostly zero and l3_collision would be left to the bounded-distance sphere, which does not itself spread code usage; a single-batch frozen gamma is also a one-sample scale, so the <=0.35 hypothesis is only weakly grounded."}, {"idea_id": "ANCHORLADDER-RQ", "position": 5, "reason": "Ranks last because its deep level is Euclidean by construction (c = (-1, -0.5, 0)): at level 3 the per-item behaviour anchor drops out (exp = identity) and no dispersion force replaces it, so the predicted level-3 assi

gnment is exactly the plain Euclidean RQ whose 0.549 l3_collision E6 shows above its own 0.35 criterion, and its <=0.35 hypothesis therefore has no support in the bundle; the behaviour signal survives only where curvature is non-zero, and the spec's B=256 does not match the frozen ~1023-item batch in the cost statement."}], "objection": "The three sign-inversion candidates (TAPERINNOV, signcurv, dualramp) and the two transport-balance candidates (strataot, TAPERINNOV) all predict their gain from a level-3 occupancy device, yet the round trains one arm only, so no candidate can separate 'curvature+behaviour coupling' from 'plain code balancing', and if the single run does land above 0.065 the credit assignment stays open; specifically for my top pick, the balanced Sinkhorn is a batch-level constraint on ~1023 items over 256 codes, so the argmin used at assignment/evaluation need not inherit the balance and l3_collision could return above the gate while training diagnostics look healthy, and the -1 sign on the level-3 behaviour term can suppress exactly the deep-position predictability that E6/E7 show distinguishes the 0.062-0.0638 arms (resample T3/T4 NLL 0.73/0.05) from the collapsed 0.0467 arm, so a recall regression there would be indistinguishable from a wrong dispersion device under a single no-early-stopping run."}
